faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Field Worker position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Field Worker post at Punjab Agricultural University is 03-09-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Field Worker role?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Field Worker position must be at least 18 years old and not exceed 50 years of age as per the recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Worker post?
faq.answer: A Graduate degree in any discipline, with a preference for Agriculture or Botany, is required. Additionally, knowledge of Punjabi up to the Matriculation level is mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Field Worker position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Field Worker post will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 18,000/- per month, along with an additional 18% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Field Worker role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Field Worker position involves two main stages: initial document screening followed by a personal interview. Candidates must perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the PAU Field Worker recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 200/- for all categories, including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates, as mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the PAU Field Worker recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q8. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates must attach self-attested copies of necessary documents, including a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational certificates, along with the filled application form.

faq.question: Q9. Does PAU offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not explicitly mention age relaxation for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for detailed information on age relaxation policies.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Field Worker position at PAU?
faq.answer: The Field Worker position at Punjab Agricultural University is a contractual role. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the terms and conditions of the contract.
